items.title: VEGAS DINING NEWS: Chinese Chef Defects from Wynn to Fontainebleau, Tenshou Walk-Thru
items.why: A Chinese chef is leaving Wynn for Fontainebleau in Las Vegas, and the Tenshou restaurant has held a walk-through.
